    Machine learning-based rainfall prediction: Unveiling insights and forecasting for improved preparedness

    Published in IEEE Access (Impact Factor: 3.6), 2023

    Investigates advanced machine learning algorithms and meteorological dataset pre-processing for long-term rainfall forecasting.

    Recommended citation: Hassan, Md. Mehedi, Mohammad Abu Tareq Rony, Md Asif Rakib Khan, et al. (First & Corresponding Author †). (2023). "Machine learning-based rainfall prediction: Unveiling insights and forecasting for improved preparedness." IEEE Access, IEEE, Vol. 11: 132196–132222.
